✈️ TRAVEL⚡ 36 SEC

At Taylor's University, even the area right in front of the campus was attractive 🎓

🎓 Day 1 Visit

Taylor's University, which I visited on day 1 of the university visits.

It is the university where an Indian student gave us a campus tour.

🌳 The Campus

This is the campus of Taylor's University.

A lawn spreads out, and in the back, you can also see a small lake.

🏢 Right In Front

Really right in front of the Taylor's campus, there were student dorms and a building like a shopping street.

It is not really a shopping street, but a bright building with an open atrium.

There were things like a food court there.

✨ Both Were Great

Taylor's University itself was attractive.

And the dorms and buildings right in front of the university were also very attractive.
